title: Multiple instances of the "Add a link" dialog
claim: Repeated link-command activation created concurrent link dialogs.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. The link command detects the named open panel, restores editor focus when needed, closes it, and returns before opening another dialog.
proofRelation: The closing commit changed only source. The current test tree has no link-dialog multiplicity regression.
auditChange: Confirms link UI is owned jointly by the link bundle and generic dialog lifecycle; it does not change the current winner.
reason: Current source contains the fix, but Wordgard still owns the missing exact browser regression.
nextAction: Add a browser test that activates Mod-k twice and asserts one dialog panel.

title: Look into how browsers handle text direction in lists
claim: Direction stored on a list-item textblock does not reliably place list markers or align text in Firefox and Chrome.
currentSourceTruth: Open. Direction remains a textblock mark and state facet; no list-wrapper projection propagates the direction contract to list marker layout.
proofRelation: Bidi state tests cover cursor logic, not browser list marker placement or Firefox list alignment.
auditChange: Downgrades Wordgard direction behavior from complete to partial at the product/DOM boundary; the data model is stronger than its list rendering contract.
reason: The open browser-layout contract belongs to Wordgard; no Plate/Plite source change follows from it.
nextAction: Define list direction projection and add Firefox/Chromium browser rows.

title: Firefox Android issues
claim: Firefox Android moves the DOM selection before beforeinput, causing select-all deletion/replacement to use the wrong range and destabilize later input.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed in source. Selectionchange records are staged and interpreted during flush, with touch recency used only to label pointer selection.
proofRelation: The observed 733-test Chrome run is both desktop-only and stale-dist; no Firefox Android or current-head raw-device regression proves this sequence.
auditChange: Strengthens the raw-mobile proof gap: a source fix exists, but no applicable device proof supports an exact mobile-input claim.
reason: Source fix is present; raw Firefox Android coverage remains Wordgard-owned.
nextAction: Run select-all delete and replacement on Firefox Android with trace/video evidence.

title: Cursor mismatch on Android with Google Voice Typing
claim: Chrome Android voice typing emits stacked DOM deletions and insertions that made the visible caret diverge from the model selection.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed according to the maintainer. The current input owner maintains a DOM document plus lazy mappings and reconciles stacked native changes before mapping target ranges into state.
proofRelation: Desktop DOM-change tests cover stacked mapping primitives, but no current Google Voice Typing device test exists.
auditChange: Provides concrete donor evidence for canonical native-DOM reconciliation while keeping its mobile proof status partial.
reason: Maintainer-reported device success is not a retained regression artifact.
nextAction: Retain a Chrome Android voice-typing trace that asserts DOM, document, and caret convergence.

title: leftover code from the CM6
claim: Two runtime error messages retained CodeMirror branding.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. Plugin crash and duplicate-package diagnostics use Wordgard terminology.
proofRelation: A current source search is sufficient for this non-behavioral string cleanup.
auditChange: Terminology cleanup only; no architecture or proof conclusion changes.
reason: Not an editor behavior or reusable architecture invariant.
nextAction: None.

title: TypeScript declaration error: Property `isTextblock` does not exist on type `Plot`
claim: Bundled declarations resolved Pos.Plot.node to the namespace-local position class instead of the document Plot class.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed in source through out-of-namespace type aliases. A fresh declaration build cannot currently prove the published surface because issue #32 breaks type checking first.
proofRelation: No retained compile-only regression exists, and the frozen head cannot emit clean declarations while schema/code.ts is broken.
auditChange: The namespace-emission hazard remains relevant to packaging, but #32 already owns the current build-proof downgrade.
reason: Source shape is corrected; packed declaration proof is blocked by the current build failure.
nextAction: After #32, compile the original consumer against the packed declaration bundle.

title: Can't delete text across ranges in Origin Tracking example
claim: The Origin Tracking example mishandled deletions spanning multiple attribution ranges.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed in the website example. BlameMap.update walks preserved and replaced gaps and merges adjacent equal-color sections.
proofRelation: The reporter manually confirmed the website fix; there is no retained automated example regression.
auditChange: Confirms the attribution example concepts found by the website audit; it does not alter the core editor comparison.
reason: Website source is fixed but the example has no automated cross-range deletion proof.
nextAction: Add an example runner row for deletion across adjacent attribution ranges.

title: iOS autocorrect removes the word and doesn’t replace it as expected
claim: iOS autocorrect deleted the misspelled word instead of inserting its replacement.
currentSourceTruth: Closed after the reporter could no longer reproduce on 0.1.2. No dedicated fixing commit was identified; current native-input reconciliation is the plausible owner.
proofRelation: Reporter confirmation is the only exact evidence. The test suite has composition rows but no iOS autocorrect device row.
auditChange: Prevents treating the closure as source-proven and adds another required case to the raw iOS proof dossier.
reason: The symptom disappeared, but no attributable source delta or durable iOS proof exists.
nextAction: Add iOS autocorrect replacement with document/caret convergence assertions.

title: Create a footnote example
claim: Wordgard lacked a nested-editor footnote example.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed in the website. The example defines an inline Footnote plot, projects it through a tooltip-hosted inner editor, and synchronizes inner/outer transactions.
proofRelation: The example exists, but the website has no retained end-to-end nested-editor verification.
auditChange: Confirms the independently source-derived nested synchronization and shared focus/history concepts; the issue does not expand or revise the union.
reason: Implementation exists without automated example proof.
nextAction: Exercise outer/inner edit, undo, focus transfer, and teardown in the website example runner.

title: Create a CodeMirror-for-editing-code-blocks example
claim: Wordgard lacks a CodeMirror-backed code-block editing example.
currentSourceTruth: Open. The website bundles CodeMirror modules for its playground, but no site/examples/codemirror example integrates a nested code editor.
proofRelation: Repository inventory proves the example is absent; there is no applicable runtime proof.
auditChange: Product/example breadth gap only; Plate already wins this layer.
reason: Open donor example request; no local Plate/Plite patch is justified.
nextAction: Wordgard may add a nested code-editor example with focus/history ownership proof.

title: Create a user interface for choosing a value for `CodeBlockLanguage`
claim: CodeBlockLanguage has no keyboard-accessible value-selection UI.
currentSourceTruth: Open. The language mark type exists and fenced-code input tries to apply it, but no menu control selects a value; that input-rule source is also currently missing imports.
proofRelation: Mark serialization tests exist; no UI or accessibility test covers choosing a language.
auditChange: Product-control gap; #32 separately changes the build audit.
reason: Open Wordgard product feature with no local adoption consequence.
nextAction: Define the value-picker owner and prove keyboard/screen-reader operation.

title: Provide a practical collaborative editing system
claim: The collaboration algorithm lacks a packaged practical client/server transport and complete operational documentation.
currentSourceTruth: Open. The package owns versioned client queues, receive/send helpers, transforms, corrections, and shared effects; sendableUpdate reserves a send by mutating CollabState. The practical client/server remains ad hoc website example code.
proofRelation: Retained test source covers convergence, starvation transforms, corrections, effects, and random input. Its observed execution resolved stale dist, and transport reconnect, persistence, authentication, and server lifecycle remain unproved.
auditChange: Keeps algorithmic collaboration exact but downgrades any claim of a complete practical collaboration system to partial. The observational-snapshot purity finding is independently source-derived, not issue-created.
reason: The remaining productized transport/server work belongs to Wordgard.
nextAction: Separate algorithm proof from a packaged client/server contract and operational example.

title: Look into supporting autocompletion in the core lib
claim: Wordgard has no completion provider/query/selection/accept/cancel lifecycle.
currentSourceTruth: Open. Generic tooltip primitives exist, but there is no completion state, query lifecycle, command, or feature bundle.
proofRelation: No implementation means no applicable test.
auditChange: Adds an issue-derived requirement row, but rejects centralizing completion in editor Core: Plate feature owners and copied UI already own the applicable product behavior.
reason: Open donor requirement with no implemented Wordgard contract to transplant.
nextAction: Keep completion feature-owned in Plate; Wordgard must first define and prove its own lifecycle before it can be a donor.

title: Cannot change menu bar's `top`
claim: An inline top style made the sticky menu panel impossible to offset with host CSS.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. Panel groups carry top/bottom classes and the base theme owns default offsets, allowing host CSS to override them.
proofRelation: Reporter confirmation exists; no panel CSS regression test is retained.
auditChange: Reaffirms CSS—not imperative DOM style—as the correct panel-layout owner.
reason: Source fix exists without exact browser style proof.
nextAction: Add a host-theme override assertion for top and bottom panel classes.

title: After use Ctrl+A to select all, Ctrl+X cause a "ValidationError"
claim: Keyboard select-all followed by cut could delete the document into an invalid shape.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. Cut changes use schema fitting and explicitly remap a valid nearby selection after deletion.
proofRelation: ChangeSet fitting has strong unit coverage, but no exact Ctrl/Cmd-A then cut browser regression is retained.
auditChange: Confirms clipboard deletion must pass through schema-aware replacement fitting.
reason: Source fix is present; exact browser interaction proof is absent.
nextAction: Add keyboard and mouse select-all cut rows against a non-empty-root schema.

title: Range wrapper decorations don't redraw when their attributes change
claim: Range-wrapper attribute changes were ignored because equality compared the new element with itself.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. WrapperRangeDecoration.eq compares the other element with this element.
proofRelation: Exact browser regression source updates wrapper class a to b. The observed 733-test run imported ignored dist built at 01eb2b5, seven commits behind frozen head, so it is not current-head execution proof.
auditChange: Downgrades current-head decoration proof to partial: fixed source and exact regression source exist, but the only observed execution is stale-dist.
reason: The exact upstream test source exists, but no run executes it against frozen-head runtime artifacts.
nextAction: Repair the current build, resolve test imports to rebuilt current-head output, and rerun the exact row with module-resolution proof.

title: Point decoration at the end of the document isn't redrawn when it changes

currentSourceTruth: Fixed. Widget invalidation preserves zero-width changed sections at the document boundary.
proofRelation: Exact browser regression source flips the end widget x to y. The observed 733-test run imported ignored dist built at 01eb2b5, seven commits behind frozen head, so it is not current-head execution proof.
auditChange: Downgrades current-head widget proof to partial: fixed source and exact regression source exist, but the only observed execution is stale-dist.
reason: The exact upstream test source exists, but no run executes it against frozen-head runtime artifacts.
nextAction: Repair the current build, resolve test imports to rebuilt current-head output, and rerun the exact row with module-resolution proof.

title: A lower decoration change is lost when a higher one changes too
claim: Merging simultaneous point and range decoration changes dropped the lower change.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. joinRanges indexes the source list correctly and invalidation tracks the last appended end per source.
proofRelation: Exact browser regression source changes a point and range in one transaction. The observed 733-test run imported ignored dist built at 01eb2b5, seven commits behind frozen head, so it is not current-head execution proof.
auditChange: Downgrades current-head invalidation proof to partial: fixed source and exact regression source exist, but the only observed execution is stale-dist.
reason: The exact upstream test source exists, but no run executes it against frozen-head runtime artifacts.
nextAction: Repair the current build, resolve test imports to rebuilt current-head output, and rerun the exact row with module-resolution proof.

title: coordsAtPos returns the block's far edge instead of the caret's line start next to a block widget
claim: coordsAtPos returned the far edge near a block-display widget placed inside an inline-content plot.
currentSourceTruth: Closed as unsupported/by-design. side -1 places the widget before the cursor, and block-display widgets inside inline content are outside the supported rendering contract.
proofRelation: No source fix or regression test exists because the reproduction violates the supported widget/layout contract.
auditChange: Clarifies a contract boundary; it does not create a supported invariant to compare or adopt.
reason: The reported geometry expectation depends on an unsupported block-widget/inline-content combination.
nextAction: Document the unsupported combination if users can reach it through public APIs.

title: Arrow / line-boundary movement crashes on a doc that is its own textblock
claim: Vertical motion crashed when the document root itself was the textblock.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. Vertical motion uses the document tile when a textblock position has no parent instead of reading before on the top node.
proofRelation: Retained browser test source covers general vertical motion, but the observed execution is stale-dist and none use a document root with direct inline content.
auditChange: No architecture delta; this is a fixed boundary case with a missing exact regression.
reason: Current source contains the fix; exact top-level-textblock proof is absent.
nextAction: Add the reported direct-inline document schema to moveVertically browser tests.

title: Caret drawn after the trailing space when arrowing across a soft wrap
claim: Horizontal motion across a soft wrap drew the caret after collapsed trailing whitespace.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed by forward-biasing logical motion except at bidi boundaries; current logical movement returns a forward side.
proofRelation: Retained unit-test source covers logical and bidi movement, but the observed execution is stale-dist and no browser soft-wrap caret regression is retained.
auditChange: Confirms the cursor-side policy but does not change the current architecture verdict.
reason: Source policy is present; layout-sensitive proof is absent.
nextAction: Add a fixed-width Chrome/Firefox soft-wrap motion row.

title: `GardState.readOnly.of(true)` only partially working
claim: readOnly prevented only some mutation paths, while menus and commands could still edit.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed across command, menu, input, history, schema, and table owners. Text selection remains allowed by design; focusability/editable is a separate facet.
proofRelation: The current test tree contains no cross-surface readOnly contract test.
auditChange: Confirms readOnly is authoring policy, not selection/focus policy; no winner changes.
reason: Broad source fix exists without one exact cross-surface proof.
nextAction: Exercise keyboard, menus, paste/drop, history, and table mutations under readOnly.

title: Extra space at start of line with iOS swipe input
claim: iOS swipe input at line start can insert an extra leading space through stale autocapitalization context.
currentSourceTruth: Open. Wordgard now delegates Enter and Backspace to native input on iOS/Android, but the maintainer explicitly describes this as mitigation rather than a complete autocapitalization fix.
proofRelation: Only the issue recording exercises the symptom; no raw iOS regression exists.
auditChange: Hard evidence that Wordgard mobile-input correctness and proof are partial, not exact.
reason: The issue remains open and requires a real iOS keyboard/device lane.
nextAction: Reproduce on current iOS, capture event/DOM/model trace, then retain a raw-device row.

title: iOS swipe input deleted character-by-character
claim: iOS swipe-input backspace deleted a word character-by-character instead of honoring native word deletion.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed by delegating mobile Backspace to beforeinput/native behavior rather than intercepting keydown.
proofRelation: No raw iOS swipe/backspace regression is retained.
auditChange: Adds a mandatory swipe-backspace case to the raw mobile proof dossier; source policy alone is insufficient proof.
reason: Source fix exists without device proof.
nextAction: Retain iOS swipe-word then Backspace behavior on a raw device.

title: Error when moving cursor through inline plot
claim: Cursor entry/exit through an inline plot with inline content produced an index error and blocked editing.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. TextblockMap.toIndex clips and advances atom/structural sections without the prior negative-offset error.
proofRelation: Selection unit tests cover inline-content nodes, but no exact browser editing/cursor regression for the reported plot exists.
auditChange: Qualifies the textblock-projection proof: the mechanism is present, but nested inline-content browser behavior has only adjacent coverage.
reason: Current source is fixed; exact browser proof is absent.
nextAction: Add editable inline-plot cursor entry, edit, and exit browser coverage.

title: Pasting code from vscode to wordgard editor cause an error.
claim: Pasting VS Code block HTML could crash parse.slice and corrupt the rendered editor.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. Slice parsing avoids closing the top parse context and chooses a block parent when unmatched input contains multiple blocks.
proofRelation: Exact parser regression source covers multiple unmatched block elements. The observed 733-test run imported ignored dist built at 01eb2b5, seven commits behind frozen head, so it is not current-head execution proof.
auditChange: Downgrades current-head parser proof to partial: fixed source and exact regression source exist, but the only observed execution is stale-dist.
reason: The exact upstream test source exists, but no run executes it against frozen-head runtime artifacts.
nextAction: Repair the current build, resolve test imports to rebuilt current-head output, and rerun the exact row with module-resolution proof.

title: Make key bindings discoverable, somehow
claim: Active key bindings are not discoverable to pointer, keyboard, or screen-reader users.
currentSourceTruth: Open. Key bindings compile into handlers and menu items expose descriptions, but menu metadata does not link active shortcuts and there is no binding-help surface.
proofRelation: No discoverability/accessibility implementation or proof exists.
auditChange: Adds an issue-derived accessibility requirement for resolved active-shortcut metadata and discovery, while retaining insufficient evidence for a public API.
reason: A one-paragraph donor issue is insufficient evidence for a Plate/Plite public API.
nextAction: Defer for research; gather concrete menu, keyboard, screen-reader, and help-surface requirements before API design.

title: Editor silently stops applying input after an exception during flush()
claim: An exception before the flush try/finally stranded the editor in flushing state and rejected every later dispatch.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed narrowly. takeDirty and viewState.flush now run inside try/finally, so the flushing flag is restored; the maintainer explicitly warns that a mid-update exception may still leave corrupted editor state.
proofRelation: No regression injects a pre-update flush exception and proves recovery or state integrity.
auditChange: Downgrades any broad fault-recovery reading: Wordgard restores the scheduler flag, not transactional editor state.
reason: Source guard exists; recovery integrity is explicitly unproved.
nextAction: Inject failures in takeDirty, projection, plugin update, read, and write phases and assert the intended recovery contract.

title: Setting any attribute on `contentDOM` crashes mutation processing
claim: Direct attribute writes on contentDOM crashed MutationObserver processing at the root tile.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed. Root-tile attribute mutations are ignored; the supported ownership path remains the contentAttributes facet, which may overwrite direct embedder writes.
proofRelation: Tests cover facet-provided content attributes and child attribute repair, not a direct root contentDOM mutation.
auditChange: Clarifies ownership: root attributes are declarative facet state, while direct host mutations are tolerated but not authoritative.
reason: Source fix and adjacent tests exist; the exact root mutation is untested.
nextAction: Add a root attribute mutation row and document facet ownership.

title: Attributes.compare doesn't score attributes that only exist in the new element
claim: Attributes.compare ignored attributes present only in the new element, preventing wrapper restyling.
currentSourceTruth: Fixed at the frozen head. The comparison now penalizes unmatched attributes after the old list is exhausted.
proofRelation: No exact Attributes.compare or added-attribute wrapper regression was added with the fix.
auditChange: The frozen source includes the fix; issue #31, not this closed row, changes the decoration-invalidation verdict.
reason: Source fix exists without exact retained proof.
nextAction: Add direct compare symmetry and wrapper-added-style browser assertions.

title: RangeSet.compareRange misses ranges that start before the compared window
claim: RangeSet.compareRange skips a range that starts before the compared window and extends into it.
currentSourceTruth: Open and reproduced by inspection at the frozen head. Both scans start at the first range whose start is inside the window, so an already-open range is omitted.
proofRelation: The exact issue is absent from retained Chrome test source, and the observed 733-test execution resolved stale dist; neither proves spanning-range invalidation at frozen head.
auditChange: Material downgrade: Wordgard decoration invalidation is partial with a known correctness defect, and pagination-style wrapper reuse cannot cite it as exact.
reason: The donor bug has an exact reproduction and remains open; this audit must record rather than patch it.
nextAction: Fix the open-range comparison and retain the issue reproduction as a browser regression.

title: main doesn't build: unresolved names in src/schema/code.ts
claim: The frozen main branch does not typecheck because schema/code.ts has unresolved names and schema/index.ts exports a missing symbol.
currentSourceTruth: Open and directly reproduced. enter and CodeBlockLanguage are not imported, codeBlockLanguage is not defined, and InputRule is unused.
proofRelation: npx tsc --noEmit fails with five errors. npm run prepare prints the same failure but exits zero, so the build script is false-green.
auditChange: Material downgrade: current Wordgard build/declaration/package proof is failed, and prepare cannot be treated as a trustworthy gate.
reason: Exact current source failure belongs to Wordgard and blocks release-quality proof.
nextAction: Repair schema exports/imports and make bin/build.ts propagate typecheck failure.

title: Adding link on footnote superscript has buggy tooltips
claim: Applying a link to a footnote superscript can create overlapping outer-link and nested-footnote tooltips with unstable interaction.
currentSourceTruth: Open. Link tooltip computation accepts any linked node before the cursor, while the footnote example separately projects a tooltip-hosted inner editor; neither owner excludes or coordinates the other.
proofRelation: The issue contains manual visual evidence; no nested-tooltip interaction test exists.
auditChange: Adds a concrete nested-editor/tooltip ownership defect; the footnote example is not complete integration proof.
reason: Open website integration bug; no local Plate/Plite source change is authorized.
nextAction: Choose mark projection and tooltip arbitration ownership, then add the reported interaction row.

title: Suggestion: Make dialogs more modal
claim: Dialogs are non-modal panels, so the editor, selection, and other controls remain mutable while a dialog awaits resolution.
currentSourceTruth: Open. Dialog.show appends panel constructors to a field and renders a custom wg-dialog element; it does not use HTMLDialogElement, inert state, or selection/update locking.
proofRelation: Manual issue evidence only; no modal focus/inertness test exists.
auditChange: Downgrades Wordgard dialogs from a complete dialog contract to a panel/promise primitive without modal interaction guarantees.
reason: Open donor API/product decision.
nextAction: Decide true modal versus explicitly non-modal semantics and prove focus, inertness, cancellation, and layout stability.

title: Suggestion: Make link editor a tooltip instead of dialog
claim: The link editor is a top panel dialog rather than an anchored editable tooltip.
currentSourceTruth: Open preference request. Link creation/editing uses Dialog.show; the existing link tooltip only renders the target as a read-only anchor.
proofRelation: No editable link-tooltip implementation or proof exists.
auditChange: Product taste request; it does not establish a superior reusable mechanism by itself.
reason: Open donor product request, not a current invariant.
nextAction: None for Plate/Plite without a separate product/API decision.
